terminal_or_classified_outcomes.result: All six cells reached a preserved terminal classification; position 6 is an explicit 300-second runtime timeout, not a missing record.

failure_traceability.result: Every nominal semantic miss has a visible check ID, but seven failed-check instances rely on hidden exact-value or exact-evidence requirements that the visible criterion does not impose.

temporal_separation.result: All four schema-valid reports passed incident_start_utc, last_observed_utc and recovery_status independently. The fifth produced report contained the same correct three values but stopped at the schema gate.

normalization_policy.result: One completed Pi response contained exactly one intact JSON object with surrounding text and was normalized as predeclared. Four reports were already strict JSON; the timed-out response contained no complete final object.

human_calibration.result: Manual comparison of every produced report with its visible task, fixture evidence and frozen truth found three classes of verifier false negative.

human_calibration_findings.observation: The reports identify the correct service and journey in ordinary language, but the verifier requires an exact underscore-delimited hidden string for the journey.
human_calibration_findings.alignment_problem: The candidate-visible task does not define primary_service or affected_user_journey as controlled codes.

human_calibration_findings.observation: Each report rejects the required alternatives and attaches direct supporting counter-evidence, but the verifier demands one exact hidden superset of event IDs.
human_calibration_findings.alignment_problem: The visible criterion requires sufficient direct counter-evidence, not every event selected by the reference author.

human_calibration_findings.observation: The report classifies the skewed-node rejection as a symptom and a user-facing intermittent-reject signal as impact. Both follow the visible guidance, while hidden truth additionally requires the first event as root-cause evidence and the second as a symptom.
human_calibration_findings.alignment_problem: The visible contract neither requires duplicate citations of one event under multiple roles nor makes its impact guidance subordinate to one hidden reference-author role choice.

candidate_attributable_findings.observation: The retry reports omit a required immediate-retry waypoint; the clock-skew report places the skewed-host rejection after its user-facing edge error instead of reconstructing corrected causal order.
The Pi report uses rationale instead of the required reason field in uncertainty items. No official downstream semantic checks were performed.
Pi reached the predeclared 300-second active-time limit during its fourth turn while emitting the final report; no complete final object or valid agent termination was observed.
The one intact report object was recovered without internal repair. Semantic failure remained independent of transport compliance.

counterfactual_diagnostics.purpose: Identify benchmark defects, not rescore frozen outcomes.

schema_only_repair_position_4.mutation: Rename uncertainties[].rationale to uncertainties[].reason in memory.
schema_only_repair_position_4.result: 14/15 checks; only the overconstrained distractor_rejection check remains.

required_repairs: Expose canonical scope values or verify semantically equivalent service and journey strings.
Represent sufficient alternative counter-evidence as accepted evidence groups instead of one mandatory exhaustive event set.
Remove hidden duplicate-role and single-reference-role requirements or state multi-role evidence semantics explicitly.
Retain the now validated temporal definitions, strict schema gate, frozen response normalizer and 300-second user-facing timeout.
Requalify references and targeted near misses offline, then freeze another small confirmation before any broad model sweep.

interpretation_limits: The study cannot estimate reliability, quality stochasticity or latency tails.
Mini and Pi are complete deployed systems, not an isolated one-factor harness experiment.
Timing is descriptive and was observed under documented Spotlight and Docker background load.
The human calibration does not overwrite or rescore the frozen official 0/6 result.
